**TIP:** If you are using one of the many available accounting software packages for billing and accounts receivable processing, check it first to see if it prepares the aging schedule automatically. Most accounting software packages will prepare an accounts receivable aging schedule at the touch of a button and all you need to do is add the MWBE status and ESD funds used.
